    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const p = url.pathname.replace(/^\/empreenda\/?/, '');
    if (IMG[p]) return new Response(bin(IMG[p]), {headers:{'content-type':'image/webp','cache-control':'public, max-age=86400'}});
    if (p === '' ) return new Response(HTML, {headers:{'content-type':'text/html; charset=utf-8','cache-control':'public, max-age=300'}});
    return Response.redirect(url.origin + '/empreenda', 302);
  }
};
